scientific_scope: Prospective source-family robustness in synthetic paired choice; no generalization claim
hypothesis: A train-only smooth source-family loss-weighted gradient, with unchanged training examples and epochs, improves worst-source sealed accuracy over hard worst-family minibatch minimax without material family harm.

algorithm.control: R28 hard worst-family selection using training-only hinge losses and 576 examples from the selected source per epoch
algorithm.candidate: Compute mean hinge loss for each of three families from training rows only. Compute stable exp(loss-maxloss) normalized family weights (temperature=1). Sum per-family signed gradients from margin <=0 examples, each divided by 576; average the three family gradients by these frozen-per-epoch normalized loss weights; apply exactly 32 updates. No sealed observation or update during training.

outcomes: PARTIAL_SMOOTH_GAIN if at least two blocks have worst-family gain >=0.02
decision_rule.invalidity: Any source or frozen identity drift, duplicate or overlapping cohort, nonfinite numeric, altered budget, inconsistent independent metrics or replay causes INVALID; interrupted first-use is CONSUMED_INDETERMINATE and may not be replayed
